name: text-skeleton
title: Text skeleton
description: Lines of loading text with natural, uneven lengths and a short last line, each bar in the line height of the text it stands in for.
docs: Pick the size of the text it replaces (sm, base, lg or a heading level h1 to h6) and the number of lines: every bar sits in one line box of that text, so the real content moves nothing when it arrives. Line lengths come from a seed, so the block is identical on the server and in the browser; give neighbouring blocks different seeds. Wrap a screen in SkeletonGroup to announce Loading once.
